## TrailFold Daypack 18L — Static Meta Production Brief

### Shared guardrails
- Use 4:5 (1080 × 1350) as the master; export 1:1 (1080 × 1080). Keep essential text inside the central safe area.
- Show the actual Daypack 18L and only supplied/approved product assets. Do not imply the bag is waterproof or that a 15-inch laptop fits.
- Plain-spoken styling: restrained typography, natural light, neutral commuter setting, no testimonials, competitor comparisons, sustainability language, or discount callouts.
- Each concept receives one composed master plus the required crops. Total production allocation: **8 hours**.

### Media-buyer setup
Run these as three separate ads in the same existing prospecting ad set. Keep audience, optimization, placements, attribution settings, landing page, schedule, and spend equal. Use **$30/day per ad for 7 days**, reallocated from existing spend rather than added to it. The test variable is the complete creative concept; do not edit copy or imagery mid-test. Treat results as directional because no incrementality study is available. Primary read: Shopify-attributed purchases; diagnostics: outbound CTR, landing-page views, add-to-cart rate, and cost per purchase. Do not scale from this test without checking stock and replenishment timing.

concepts.name: Weekday Desk, Weekend Away
concepts.role: Iteration of the existing desk-to-trail idea
concepts.hypothesis: A cleaner weekday-to-weekend transition will retain the proven theme while making the product use case immediately legible.
concepts.headline: Built for weekdays. Ready for weekends.
concepts.body: The Daypack 18L carries your daily essentials, a 13-inch laptop, and the things you need for a short trip. Water-resistant fabric, external bottle pocket, and free US shipping.
concepts.image_composition: Single split-frame composition. Left: Daypack beside a simple desk with a closed 13-inch laptop and bottle visible. Right: the same bag near a doorway with a folded layer and small travel essentials. Keep the bag dominant and avoid mountain or extreme-adventure imagery. Overlay: “Weekday → weekend.”
concepts.production_instructions: Use one consistent camera angle and bag scale across both halves. Neutral gray or warm off-white palette; thin divider; one sans-serif typeface. Show only items that visibly fit without forcing the bag. Add a small footer: “18L Daypack.” Export 4:5 and 1:1.

test_plan.control: Current desk-to-trail static, if available; otherwise compare equally against the other two concepts
test_plan.decision_rule: Advance only if it produces the strongest Shopify purchase efficiency with no material deterioration in add-to-cart rate.

concepts.name: 13-Inch Laptop Fit, Clearly Shown
concepts.hypothesis: Stating the verified laptop-sleeve size before the click will reduce ambiguity and attract better-qualified traffic.
concepts.headline: Your 13-inch laptop has a place.
concepts.body: A practical 18L daypack with a padded sleeve designed for a 13-inch laptop, plus an external bottle pocket. Free US shipping. Estimated delivery: 4–7 business days.
concepts.image_composition: Three-quarter open-bag view with a 13-inch laptop partially inserted into the padded sleeve. Add two restrained labels with leader lines: “Padded 13-inch sleeve” and “18L capacity.” Keep the external bottle pocket visible.
concepts.production_instructions: The laptop must be a confirmed 13-inch device. Do not show or mention a 15-inch laptop. Avoid dimension diagrams unless verified measurements are supplied. Use a light background, dark text, and ample negative space. Ensure labels remain readable on mobile.

test_plan.control: Other concepts in the same ad set
test_plan.decision_rule: Advance if qualified purchase efficiency is competitive and the ad reduces low-intent clicks versus the concept average.

concepts.name: Enough Bag, Not Too Much
concepts.hypothesis: Positioning 18L as a practical middle ground for commuting and short trips will resonate more than broad adventure language.
concepts.headline: Enough bag. Not too much bag.
concepts.body: The Daypack 18L keeps the commute simple and is ready for a short weekend trip. Padded 13-inch laptop sleeve, external bottle pocket, and water-resistant fabric. Not waterproof.
concepts.image_composition: Top-down packing layout: Daypack centered, with a 13-inch laptop, bottle, folded shirt, cable pouch, and a few neutral daily essentials arranged around it. Do not include the Cable pouch as a promised accessory; visually mark it “sold separately” if the TrailFold product is used.
concepts.production_instructions: Use an editorial flat-lay with realistic spacing rather than implying every pictured item is included. Overlay the headline only; place “18L” in a small corner badge. Keep colors quiet and functional. Export 4:5 and 1:1.

test_plan.control: Other concepts in the same ad set
test_plan.decision_rule: Advance if it leads on Shopify purchase efficiency or shows a clearly stronger add-to-cart rate without weaker purchase quality.

questions: Can the team supply an approved lifestyle image set and a confirmed 13-inch laptop prop?
Is the current desk-to-trail static available as a control asset?
Should ads pause at a specific Daypack stock threshold before the replenishment arrives?
rejected_guidance: No testimonials, competitor-performance claims, waterproof claims, discounts, or unverified 15-inch laptop-fit statements were used.
